sipocs.title: Issue invoice
sipocs.description: Validates the invoice totals and moves it from Draft to Issued.

businessRules.text: Only a Draft invoice with at least one item can be issued; its total is the sum of its line totals.

suppliers.description: Picks the Draft invoice to issue

process.description: Sets the total, the issue moment and the Issued status

customers.description: The customer who receives the invoice

hard: The invoice does not exist or is not Draft

sipocs.title: Record payment
sipocs.description: Records the customer's payment and moves the invoice from Issued to Paid.

businessRules.text: Only an Issued invoice can be paid, and it is paid in full.

suppliers.description: Picks the Issued invoice the payment settles

hard: The invoice does not exist or is not Issued
